+def _bound_manifest(
+    root: Path, name: str, expected_sha256: str | None = None
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    metadata = root.lstat()
+    _require(
+        root.is_absolute() and not root.is_symlink()
+        and root.resolve(strict=True) == root
+        and stat.S_ISDIR(metadata.st_mode)
+        and stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode) == 0o700,
+        f"bound evidence root is not one real 0700 directory: {root}",
+    )
+    path = root / name
+    payload = _bytes(path)
+    if expected_sha256 is not None:
+        _require(_sha256(payload) == expected_sha256, f"manifest digest drifted: {path}")
+    _require(payload.endswith(b"\n"), f"manifest lacks terminal LF: {path}")
+    entries: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for line in payload.decode("ascii").splitlines():
+        match = re.fullmatch(
+            r"([0-9a-f]{64})  (?:\./)?([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*)", line
+        )
+        _require(match is not None, f"bound manifest line is malformed: {line!r}")
+        digest, relative = match.groups()
+        parts = Path(relative).parts
+        _require(
+            relative not in entries and not any(part in (".", "..") for part in parts),

+            artifact_path.resolve(strict=True) == artifact_path,

+        _require(_sha256(_bytes(artifact_path)) == digest, f"bound artifact drifted: {relative}")
+        entries[relative] = digest
